_meta.description: Player loadout library  -  tracks every distinct rod setup used across sessions with outcome notes. Grows over time as new journal entries are logged.

loadouts.target_fish: Smallmouth Bass, Walleye, Brown Trout (3-10 lb)
loadouts.notes: Longest X-Heavy casting rod in game. Best long-range casting setup at St-Croix. Slightly light vs 20+ lb blue cats  -  use 90% tension + Med-Fast reel speed (not full speed) to land big cats. ~1 ft/2 sec retrieval. Slow drop + fast raise technique universal.

Active lure rod. ThunderSpin 5500 SE gives good responsiveness for drop-and-raise technique. Zeus 8'10" SE upgrade tested  -  similar hit rate but less sensitivity; reel class (5500 vs 8000) matters more than rod length.

loadouts.target_fish: Smallmouth Bass, Walleye, Trout, Northern Pike, Muskie (all species), Atlantic Salmon, even Blue Catfish bycatch
loadouts.notes: Proven MVP for active fishing. Triple Runner 8 ft #5/0 is ~80% hit rate at Fairytale. Kraken 8000 SE smoother on big fish than ThunderSpin 5500. Drop-pause-raise cadence: drop to bottom, pause 4 sec, raise to level and swim 4 sec. Catches cats 23-27 lb as bycatch.

loadouts.rod_specs: X-Heavy, casting 6-8.5 Oz, MONSTER FISH ROD
loadouts.location: Saint-Croix Lake (Fairytale Docks / Floating Dock on 4-Rod Stand)
loadouts.notes: Core catfish/sturgeon producer. Large Cutbait + #8/0 for the big class (40-60+ lb); Medium Cutbait + #6/0 for volume 25-35 lb. All Unique Blue Cats (70-77 lb) came on Large Cutbait. Rod/reel wear falls on leader/line, not the rod itself. Pair with RodPod/4-Rod Stand.

New from Hellish Fighter Pack. Slots cleanly as 4th heavy bottom rod in the 4-Rod Stand configuration. Braid + Mono leader = long range + abrasion resistance. Handles 30+ lb cats with no durability issue.

loadouts.terminal: Rusty Cage Feeder 5 2/3 Oz + Mix Grand Fish Feeder
loadouts.notes: Sturgeon machine. Duck Mussel Meat on feeder confirmed producer of 40-55 lb Lake Sturgeon. Night catches reliable. Heavily taxed by 40-60 lb sturgeons at SJD  -  at St-Croix it's right-sized.

loadouts.location: Saint-Croix Lake (Fairytale / Floating Dock on 4-Rod Stand)
loadouts.notes: Supernatural Pack X-Heavy bottom rod. Theme-fitting Catfish Moustache + Horsehair leader + Monkey Skull sinker. Consistent producer alongside Heavy Chaser and Humenus.

loadouts.lure_or_bait: Golem Lure 6 ft #8/0 (swapped from Skull Jig 1 1/2 Oz #5/0 + Silicone Finger 3")
loadouts.target_fish: Muskie Golem (monster), Clear Muskie, Tiger Muskie, Northern Pike
loadouts.location: Saint-Croix Lake (King of Green Bay  -  Golem fight)
loadouts.notes: MONSTER KILLER. Caught the Muskie Golem 77.984 lb + Unique Clear Muskie 56.9 lb + Trophy Clear Muskie + multiple Northern Pike on Golem Lure 6 ft #8/0. Steel Leader essential for muskie/pike bite-off. Level 36 required for Golem mission unlock.

Repurposed from match float duty to match-style bottom cat rig. Armored Slider + Medium Cutbait works because it's bottom bait, not float (Fairytale's dock-ward current kills float rigs). Originally stashed for being too short on range  -  now useful in mid-range bottom role.

Original Zeus 8'2" setup  -  drop-jig MVP for smaller aggressive bottom fish. Drop/4s-pause/raise/4s-swim cadence crushed smallies. Range slightly short for Fairytale sweet spots  -  had to cast from dock edge.
Early setup before Triple Runner discovery. Moderate success on bass, walleye, occasional trout from boat mid-lake. Superseded by Triple Runner crankbait rigs on 4/08.
Early bottom rig with oversized #10/0 hook - later downsized to #6/0 and #8/0 for better hookup rates. Hook was too big for consistent hookups.
Original setup had fluorocarbon leader - wrong choice for muskie/pike (bite-off risk). Upgraded to Titanium leader .014" + Large Minnows on 4/09 which caught Clear Muskie 16 lb.
Light float rig for small baitfish/panfish. Minor role in early loadout.
Crayfish jig combo for bass. Moderate performer. Later replaced Crayfish with Worm 5" (4/09) for better results.
Early crankbait setup before Triple Runner. Replaced same day by Thorn Jighead 5/8 Oz #2/0 + Bionic Slug 4.7" which landed UNIQUE Blue Catfish 63.758 lb.
Landed UNIQUE Blue Catfish 63.758 lb - 10th unique milestone. Proven catfish-on-jig killer before Triple Runner era.
Original Mokonzi bottom config with Fileur reel before Ambusher 9000 SE/feeder conversion. Solid heavy bottom producer.
First confirmed sturgeon catch: 42.809 lb at marker during 7-8 AM window. Duck Mussel Meat validated as sturgeon bait. Later switched to Large Cutbait for catfish duty on 4/09.

loadouts.terminal: Open Feeder 4 1/2 Oz + Mix Grand Fish Feeder
loadouts.notes: CONFIRMED volume catfish combo: Medium Cutbait + #6/0 hook with Mix Grand Fish Feeder groundbait. Filled 50-fish keeper. Lure XP bonus was 10x over bait rigs.
Tested as Triple Runner alternative. ~40-50% hit rate vs Triple Runner's 80%. SKIP - not worth swapping.
Tested as Triple Runner alternative. ~40-50% hit rate, underperformed significantly. SKIP.
Upgraded from Crayfish 4" to Worm 5" with heavier jighead. Better bass producer than crayfish version.
Panfish/exploration rod added for challenges. Caught Trophy American Shad 6.914 lb on shrimp. Good for species variety runs.
Temporary muskie/pike/sturgeon configuration on Mokonzi using Large Minnows. Rolled back to feeder/Duck Mussel Meat for sturgeon specialization.

loadouts.target_fish: Muskie, Clear Muskie, Tiger Muskie, Northern Pike
loadouts.notes: Corrected muskie float setup - Titanium leader replaces fluorocarbon (muskie bite-off fix). Landed Clear Muskie 16.023 lb and Tiger Muskie on Large Minnows.
Alternative muskie lure - caught 9.861 lb Muskie. Viable but secondary to Triple Runner/Large Minnows combos.
Landed Trophy White Bass 3.911 lb. Secondary lure for bass variety during exploration challenges.
Compact casting rod for SJD active lures. Used alongside Narrow Spoon/Buzzbait/Spinnerbait swaps. Short length limited long-range needs.
Diversified rig for SJD Ichthyologist challenge. Caught White Catfish on Night Crawlers. Useful for species variety.
Bass Jig + Worm 2" produced Largemouth 2.418 lb. Also tested with Newts 3" successfully. Solid bass combo at SJD.
Float carp rod adapted for cutbait. Part of diversified SJD challenge loadout.
Dedicated carp specialist setup. Landed Common Carp 8.186 lb on Banana Sinking Boilies. Purpose-built carp rig works as designed.
Landed 5 White Sturgeon (39-54 lb) at Fishing the Beaver hotspot. Heavily taxed by 40-60 lb sturgeons - durability damage significant. Need 3x X-Heavy bottom rods for volume.
Float rig caught Striped Bass 15.547 lb and Steelhead 12.7 lb on Large Minnows. Good predator float setup for SJD.

loadouts.target_fish: Crucian Carp, European Perch, Common Roach, Young Common Carp, European Bitterling
loadouts.notes: First telescopic deployment. Troy 23' + Pinkies under float worked efficiently for Euro panfish completion. Handled the 1 lb crucian/perch class cleanly. Useful for Exploration missions despite low fish density.

loadouts.target_fish: European Perch, Crucian Carp, Marble Trout
loadouts.notes: Light jig-worm combo for Euro panfish finesse. Works for mid-size perch and crucian. Light action necessary for 1-3 lb Tiber species. Narrow Spoon 3/4 Oz and Barbless Nano Spinner 1/8 Oz #1/0 outperformed for active lures.
Drop-and-pause technique (same as St-Croix) produced Trophy Brown Trout 3.83 lb. Proven cross-location cadence. Also caught Marble Trout 3-4 lb class.

loadouts.target_fish: European Chub (Unique + Trophy), European Perch (Unique + Trophy), Marble Trout (Trophy), European Grayling, Creek Brown Trout
loadouts.notes: MVP ACTIVE LURE at Tiber. Barbless Nano Spinner 1/8 Oz #1/0 produced Unique European Chub 4.034 lb + Unique European Perch 3.007 lb + multiple trophies. Small spinners dominate Euro river predators.

loadouts.target_fish: European Chub (Trophy), Marble Trout, Creek Brown Trout
loadouts.notes: Close second to Barbless Nano Spinner. Trophy European Chub 4.28 lb and 4.024 lb in evening window. Spinner Tail 2" add-on also productive.

loadouts.target_fish: European Perch (Trophy), Wels Catfish, Young Wels
loadouts.notes: Small hook + Leeches produced Trophy European Perch 1.129 lb at night. Wels Catfish bycatch. Much smaller hook than St-Croix cat rigs - Tiber fish are smaller.
Shiners on bottom rig for larger predators. Secondary producer at Tiber - density too low for consistent action.

loadouts.terminal: Rusty Cage Feeder 5 2/3 Oz + Mix Black Roacher groundbait
loadouts.notes: Feeder + Mix Black Roacher groundbait concentrated perch/barbel activity. Small hook (#6) + Leeches combo works for Euro river species.

loadouts.target_fish: Common Barbel (Trophy), Crucian Carp, Euro Perch
loadouts.notes: Semolina Balls on bottom produced Trophy Common Barbel 4.18 lb at night. Downsized hook (#4 vs St-Croix #8/0) to match Tiber species size.
Medium Cutbait at night produced UNIQUE European Eel 7.088 lb. Night eel fishing confirmed productive with cutbait on bottom.

loadouts.target_fish: Chinook Salmon, Chum Salmon, Sockeye Salmon (Unique 30.78 lb Chum caught)
loadouts.notes: MVP ROD at Kaniq. Medium Spoon 6/7 Oz + smooth multi-stage zig-zag retrieve produced 8+ salmon including Unique Chum 30.788 lb. Salmon hit on the DROP phase, not the raise. Titanium leader essential for pike bite-off at Kaniq.

loadouts.target_fish: Trophy Chinook Salmon (22.84 lb), Chinook (13.28 lb)
loadouts.notes: Secondary salmon lure at Kaniq. Single Spoon 1 1/2 Oz #4/0 produced Trophy Chinook 22.84 lb and Chinook 13.28 lb. Same rod as the Salmon Hunt mission setup - trying for 33+ lb Chinook Unique class in Alaska.

loadouts.rod_specs: X-Heavy Spinning, 3/4-2 1/8 Oz, 18-46 Lb, Mod Fast
loadouts.target_fish: Sockeye Salmon, Chum Salmon, Chinook Salmon
loadouts.notes: Cross-location Salmonster + Medium Spoon combo. Proven at Kaniq for all Pacific salmon species. Secondary salmon producer behind the Silverthorn.
Shorter Salmonster variant - backup salmon rod. Medium Spoon 6/7 Oz #6/0 deploys well on this rod too.
Spawn Sack feeder rig attempted at Kaniq - NO confirmed catches this session. May need specific spawning run weather/timing. Consider swapping to Salmon Eggs or Roe instead.
Short-range casting rod with Glow&Holo spoon for low-light Alaska conditions. Not a confirmed producer this session but viable alternate.

loadouts.target_fish: Tarpon, Red Drum, Black Drum, Common Snook (medium-class)
loadouts.notes: USER VERDICT: 'PERFECT for this location'  -  right balance of strength + durability for medium-weight fish at BCI. Tarpon 43.255 lb landed. Match rod with spinning reel works well as float-fishing setup with bait. 53,442/54,000 durability post-trip (untouched).

loadouts.target_fish: Largemouth Bass, Butterfly Peacock Bass, Bowfin, smaller predators
loadouts.notes: USER VERDICT: 'less than ideal'  -  line rating 6-21 Lb is too light for BCI's 30-100 lb fish. Reel speed wrong for the lures, didn't match jig sizes. Wore Patriot's Dream 4000 reel down to 27,226/46,200 (59%) durability. RECOMMENDATION: Replace with Rivertex Salmonster 8'2" (X-Heavy, 5/8-2 Oz, 15-42 Lb) for proper line capacity at BCI.

loadouts.lure_or_bait: Club-Series Glow&Holo Medium Spoon 1 Oz #4/0 (also Buzzbait 1 Oz #5/0 + Larva/Worm)
loadouts.target_fish: Striped Bass, Trophy Red Drum, Tarpon, Snook, Permit
loadouts.notes: USER VERDICT: 'IDEAL'  -  covers full lure-weight spectrum at BCI. Glow&Holo Medium Spoon 1 Oz day + night producer. **MVP COMBO** with Buzzbait 1 Oz #5/0 + Larva 4" / Worm 5" using drop-and-pause technique (bottom-bounce → mid-water raise → drop → bounce). Pause LONGER than usual on hookset. Multiple Trophy Red Drum landed. The most versatile rod at BCI.

loadouts.terminal: Drop Sinker 1 Oz + Three-way Rig 0.036" + Offset Hook #6/0
loadouts.target_fish: Trophy Bowfin, Trophy Longnose Gar, Unique Common Snook (Large Cutbait swap), Unique Gafftopsail (Craw 4" swap)
loadouts.notes: Congo three-way rig + Ribbed Shad 6" setup transferred to BCI for medium-class predators. Landed Unique Common Snook 35.843 lb (Large Cutbait swap), Unique Gafftopsail Catfish 7.621 lb (Craw 4" swap), Trophy Longnose Gar 13.530 lb (Major Popper swap), Trophy Bowfin 7.064 lb. Versatile bait-swap rig.

loadouts.target_fish: Bass shallow (Shoal/Butterfly Peacock/smaller Largemouth), smaller catfish
loadouts.notes: USER VERDICT: 'less than ideal'  -  too light for BCI's larger fish class. Wore AmericanEagle 2000 reel down to 9,242/46,200 (20% RED  -  needs repair). RECOMMENDATION: Either swap to DragonCast 7'3" NE (Heavy, 7.5-23 Lb, validated for warm-water bass at Falcon/Neherrin/Emerald) for proper line strength while keeping similar lure range, OR shelve this slot for BCI trips.

loadouts.rod_specs: X-Heavy, 6-9 7/8 Oz cast weight, 39.7-81.6 Lb, Moderate, 2-piece
loadouts.target_fish: Drum class (Black + Red), Tarpon, Wels-class catfish
loadouts.notes: **MVP for BCI Drum hunting.** Landed Unique Black Drum 82.786 lb (early night) + Unique Red Drum 66.827 lb (early night). Multiple Trophy Red Drum + Trophy Black Drum on the same Large Cutbait + bottom rig. L'impulsion 81.5 Lb drag is overkill for BCI but absorbs surprise Tarpon strikes.

loadouts.rod_specs: X-Heavy, 6-9 7/8 Oz cast weight, 39.7-81.6 Lb, Moderate, 2-piece
loadouts.target_fish: Bigmouth Buffalo, Bowfin, Trophy Brown Bullhead, Channel Catfish, mid-class species
loadouts.notes: Reliable bottom workhorse at BCI. Shiners on bottom = consistent panfish + medium-class catches. Trophy Brown Bullhead (2x) + Trophy Gafftopsail Catfish landed. Used for perimeter mapping at southern Gulf inlet on 2026-04-26.

loadouts.rod_specs: Heavy, 3/8-1 3/7 Oz, 7.5-23 Lb (Virtual Bass Open Pack)
loadouts.reel_specs: 22 Lb drag, 7.2:1 ratio, 33.5" recovery (HIGHEST ratio in casting reels)
loadouts.lure_or_bait: Grub 2.7" (note: generalist  -  attracts Bass, Bowfin, Bigmouth Buffalo)
loadouts.target_fish: Largemouth Bass (common + trophy), Bowfin (Trophy bycatch), Bigmouth Buffalo (Trophy bycatch)
loadouts.notes: VBO setup hits fast on bait + recovery, but rod is OVER-POWERED for Everglades common-class bass (3-5 lb). XP -3 arrows on Shad 4" Largemouth catches. Use this rig ONLY for trophy spots where 5-7 lb trophy / 7-10 lb unique bass are likely.

loadouts.lure_or_bait: Twin Tail Spider Grub 2" (or Crayfish 3" / Senko 5" for variation)
loadouts.notes: VALIDATED EVERGLADES BASS SETUP after 5-rod comparison test + trophy-class proof on 4/27. Light power class is the correct match for FP's XP scoring across the full bass class spread (3-5 common, 5-7 trophy, 7-10 unique). Same rod / reel / line / leader covers ALL classes  -  only the lure variant changes (Trophy Bass Jig #4/0 for 5+ lb, standard Bass Jig #3/0 for 3-5 lb). Speed 3 (medium) with this reel = trophy strike zone. Marker-ring pattern recognition validated: cast perimeter of deep zones, not center. Single-session result: Unique Largemouth 10.662 lb + 4x Trophy Largemouth 5-8 lb + Trophy Butterfly Peacock Bass 5.847 lb (NEW PB).
